# Crimson Order

The Crimson Order is a militant faction that has become one of the primary antagonistic forces in the realm. Led by the ruthless [[characters/voss|Commander Voss]], they have consolidated power across the northern territories from their fortress base at the [[locations/iron_citadel]].

## History

The Order rose to prominence during [[events/the_shattering]], a cataclysmic conflict that reshaped the political landscape. They view themselves as the rightful rulers of the realm and actively oppose the [[factions/merchant_guild]] in their expansion efforts.

## Relations

The Crimson Order maintains tense relations with the [[factions/free_cities]] coalition and has established a fragile trade agreement with the [[factions/merchant_guild]] at the [[locations/port_verath]].

## Military Strength

Under Commander Voss's leadership, the Order has grown into a formidable military power with thousands of soldiers and strategic control of key fortifications.
